svg.data-spec:
title: funcd function callers kind: flow
[External callers] gray right client: HTTP client | a Route or by name [/]
[Internal callers] amber fn2: Another Function | over a link @blue sensor: Sensor | function action step: Workflow | Function step hook: App | lifecycle hook [/]
edge: Edge @blue local: Local API | checks the link @blue chain: Invoke chain | Admit, Before, After @blue act: Activator | wakes a worker @blue workers: Workers | the Function's @blue
client > edge > chain fn2 > local > chain sensor > chain step > chain hook > chain chain > act > workers
